workflow: Manually managing WhatsApp Web session persistence and re-authentication cycles due to unstable library connections.
trigger: Session expiration or IP ban by WhatsApp's anti-spam systems during bulk messaging operations.
current_workaround: Developers write custom scripts to detect disconnection, manually trigger QR code scanning via headless browsers, and restart the node process. They often maintain a pool of multiple phone numbers/numbers to rotate when one gets banned.
consequence: Service downtime for automated notifications; significant engineering time spent on maintaining fragile connection logic rather than core business features; risk of permanent number bans.

workflow: Manual export and formatting of chat data for compliance reporting and customer history analysis.
trigger: Monthly regulatory audits or internal customer service quality reviews requiring full conversation logs.
current_workaround: Users manually export chats from WhatsApp Web/Desktop, clean up JSON/CSV files using Excel macros because the raw export includes metadata that breaks downstream parsing tools, and then upload them to CRM systems that lack native WhatsApp integration.
consequence: High risk of human error in data entry; slow turnaround for audit responses; inability to automate customer sentiment analysis due to unstructured data formats.

workflow: Building and maintaining fragile middleware to parse unsupported media types and complex message formatting from WhatsApp API responses.
trigger: Receiving messages with stickers, voice notes, or location data that standard text-parsing libraries fail to handle correctly.
current_workaround: Engineering teams build custom parsers to decode base64 encoded media streams and convert WhatsApp-specific markup (like bold/italic) into HTML/Markdown compatible with their ticketing systems. These parsers break frequently when WhatsApp updates its protocol.
consequence: Lost customer messages; incorrect routing of support tickets; increased technical debt as workarounds become more complex over time.
